messages.content: Hi there! Thanks for meeting with me today. I’m really excited to learn about your goals for the barbershop booking system. To start off, could you tell me what your main goals are for this new digital booking process?

Well, I guess we just want to make it a bit easier for customers to book appointments. You know, having options to do it online would be nice. And it would be good if they could change or cancel things without having to call in. That could save us some time.

That makes sense! So, it sounds like you want to make it easier for customers to book appointments online and allow them to change or cancel their bookings on their own. That's really helpful. 

Could you share a bit more about how you envision the online booking process working? Like, what steps do you think customers should go through when making a booking?

Honestly, I think it should be pretty straightforward. Customers should be able to pick a service, choose a barber, and then see what times are available. Just a simple process, you know? It shouldn't be too complicated for them.

Got it! So you’re thinking that customers should select a service, choose a barber, and then see available times. That sounds simple and user-friendly. 

What kind of services do you offer that you want to include in the booking system?

We have a few different services, like haircuts and beard trims. I suppose those would need to be listed, but I haven't really thought about the details too much. Just the usual stuff that we do here.

That sounds good! So you definitely want to include haircuts and beard trims as options in the booking system. 

Are there any specific times or days that the barbershop is closed or has limited hours that we should consider for the online booking?

Well, the barbers work different hours, so they’ll need to set their own availability. I guess it would be good if they could update that whenever they need to, like if they take a day off or something.

That makes sense! So, you want the barbers to be able to set and update their own availability whenever they need to, like for days off. That sounds like a great way to manage schedules. 

Lastly, can you tell me if there are any limitations or restrictions you think we should be aware of when developing this booking system?

I haven't really thought about any specific limitations. I guess just the usual things that come with managing bookings. It's important that we keep everything organized and avoid double bookings, but I prefer not to get into too much detail on that right now.

Understood! So you want to ensure that everything stays organized and that there are no double bookings, which is definitely important. 

To summarize what we've discussed so far, you want the booking system to allow customers to book online, change or cancel appointments, select services like haircuts and beard trims, have barbers manage their own availability, and avoid double bookings. 

Thank you for sharing all this information! I think I have enough to start outlining the requirements for the system.
